notes.HELD_FOR_REVIEW_NOTE: Not applied automatically: review the warnings on these suggestions first.
notes.WRITER_READ_HELD_NOTE: Changes the chapter writer or your readers could see wait for your review, because this turn drew on your notes.
notes.APPLY_FAILED_NOTE: Your words could not be applied as they stand, so every change is offered as a suggestion instead.
notes.UNLINKED_NOTE: Your words were applied, but this reply could not be linked to them — find the change in Change history to undo it.
notes.CARDS_UNSAVED_NOTE: Your words were applied, but the suggestions that came with them could not be saved — ask again to see them.
notes.IDEAS_DROPPED_NOTE: Suggestions you turned down earlier were left out.
notes.ORGANISE_STARTED_NOTE: Organising your notes has started, and its results will arrive here for your review.
notes.ORGANISE_BUSY_NOTE: Another job is running on this novel, so organising your notes waits on the card: accept it once that job finishes.
notes.ORGANISE_REFUSED_NOTE: Organising your notes could not start on its own, so it waits on the card.
